run_dataset_dataloader: run the ParallelDomain4DWAI dataset loader to sample views from synthetic AV scenes with images and depth
create_dataset_instance: create a ParallelDomain4DWAI dataset instance with a specific split, resolution, and number of views to sample
sample_specific_scene: sample a specific scene from the ParallelDomain4D dataset by setting sample_specific_scene and specific_scene_name
load_views_with_covisibility: load views from a scene using pairwise covisibility maps to sample N correlated camera viewpoints
visualize_dataset_with_rerun: visualize dataset views including RGB images, depth maps, camera poses, and 3D point clouds using Rerun
